goal: 사람이 정한 목표·마일스톤에서 요구·성공 조건·갭·작업을 연결하고 작업 전후 현재 근거로 계획을 갱신하는 하네스 절차 보강

R.description: Design changes, eight self-reviewed goal/gap scenarios and validation scope

S.description: Integrated-source context selection eight cases and actual generated-project static inspection

T.description: Actual existing scope/workflow/skill/document-index tests: 51 passed in isolated working source

I.description: Hash-checked narrow integration preserving unrelated changes; tested behavioral inputs match

D.description: Integrated repository static syntax, registry and internal-link checks passed

constraints: Preserve in-progress skill consolidation and lifecycle hook changes; no commit/push/global settings
Use existing task/evidence schema and one canonical owner for each goal/plan/task state
No new automatic scheduler, routing hook, model call or sub-agent
Small requests do not require a charter, milestone or full replanning; product UI unchanged
decisions: Human goals and execution requests; AI decomposes, assigns scopes, implements and verifies inside the authorized scope
plan-project owns gap reassessment; hooks remain metadata/reminder helpers
Design/instruction change, not implementation of an autonomous planning runtime

acceptance.condition: 사람의 목표 결정·요청과 AI의 요구 도출·작업 선택·구현·검증 경계가 명확하다
acceptance.method: Review role/scope and derived-vs-proposed requirement cases

acceptance.condition: 이전 계획과 현재 근거를 비교해 갭을 재평가하고 작업 결과를 상위 성공 조건에 연결한다
acceptance.method: Walk through before/after gap cases with current evidence and changed goal baselines

acceptance.condition: 미구현·미확인·차단·목표 변경·bottom-up 발견과 작은 요청을 구분하고 중복 상태·불필요한 승인·자동 실행을 만들지 않는다
기존 스킬·개요/계획/인수인계 양식·지도·context 선택이 연결되고 관련 검증과 시나리오로 확인된다
acceptance.method: Inspect context selection positive/negative cases, generate project fixture, validate skills/docs and run existing scope/workflow tests

next_action: Planning guidance, templates and reading rules integrated and verified; apply related goal/gap reassessment on the next authorized milestone task.
